name: Helm
slug: A helm Carlkin agreed to examine by appointment once a comrade returns.
description: A helm the party wants examined.

log.summary: Sylan asked Carlkin to examine a helm once the party's comrade returns. Carlkin agreed to schedule that examination by appointment.
notes: Sylan asked Carlkin to examine a helm once the party's comrade returns. Carlkin agreed to schedule that by appointment.

log.summary: The party also calls this worn headgear Walker's hat. Sylan wants to test whether it is the lich's phylactery, either openly or in secret. The first time Walker put it on struck Sylan as questionable, and corruption from wearing it remains an open worry. Walker neither confirms nor denies that. Dana is checking her books and a Legend Lore prophetic vision to see whether the helmet could be the phylactery; that check is unresolved. Separately, Walker wants primal stones set into the helmet for night vision, heat detection, and sight through magical darkness. He will not use his other personal jewelry for that work, and he drops the idea unless the helmet can see what he wants.
